# Callouts: Recovery 1.3 - what J14's common side is wired to (ohms)

Source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)  
Annotated image: [images/annotated/rec1-3_j14-common.jpg](../../../images/annotated/rec1-3_j14-common.jpg)

The red lead stays on J14 pin 1. The black lead goes to U15 pin 8 (3.3 V), then JP5 pin 1 (5 V), then U15 pin 4 (GND). Each reading again with the leads swapped.

| # | Ref | Identification | Part / marking | Category | Confidence | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| J14.1 | J14.1 | J14 pin 1, common side |  | Debug / programming / test | confirmed | Top pad of J14's left row, by the printed dot and '1'. Pins 1-3 and R577 are one net (beeper). Red lead here for all three readings. |
| R577 | R577 | R577 |  | Debug / programming / test | likely | The resistor just above J14 pin 1; its right end is on the common net. Where its other end goes, and so what the common side is pulled to, is what this step answers. |
| U15.8 | U15.8 | U15 pin 8, 3.3 V |  | Power | confirmed | VCC (XMC datasheet rev. J); rings to U17 OUT. Top-left lead, across from pin 1. |
| U15.4 | U15.4 | U15 pin 4, GND |  | Power | confirmed | VSS; rings to JP5 pin 2. Bottom-right lead; pin 1 is at the dimple end of the same row. |
| JP5.1 | JP5.1 | JP5 pin 1 (square), 5 V in |  | Power | confirmed | J8 supply, pins 1-6; 5.01 V measured on a working J8. Square pad, '1' printed left of it. |
| JP5.2 | JP5.2 | JP5 pin 2, GND |  | Power | confirmed | Rings to U15 pin 4. Round pad above pin 1. Not used in this step; shown so pin 1 is not mistaken. |
